items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: opendraft color, radius, elevation and motion tokens (light + dark).

@utility bg-dots.background-image: radial-gradient( var(--dot-color, color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 14%, transparent)) 1px, transparent 1px )

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion tokens
items.description: Springs, easings, durations and variants shared by every animated component.

items.name: glide-menu
items.title: Glide Menu
items.description: List whose hover highlight glides between rows.

items.name: preview-rail
items.title: Preview Rail
items.description: Tick rail with hover previews for jumping between sections.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Fifteen loading animations: spinner, dots, matrix, ASCII, metaballs and more.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Character scramble that resolves to its text.

items.name: action-swap
items.title: Action Swap
items.description: Animated label and icon swaps (roll, blur, cascade) for buttons and counters.

items.name: pixel-field
items.title: Pixel Field
items.description: Canvas pixel textures in the blue scale: mosaic, dot matrix and equalizer.

items.name: animated-sidebar
items.title: Animated Sidebar
items.description: Full sidebar system: docked, icon rail or off-canvas, mobile sheet, menus and sub-menus.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Side sheet with backdrop, focus handling and Esc / outside-click close.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K command palette with fuzzy search, groups, hints and keyboard navigation.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Range calendar in a popover or inline, with month/year choosers and min/max.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Virtualized data table: sort, resize, reorder columns, select rows, edit cells.

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice Orb
items.description: Breathing WebGL liquid orb that reacts to a voice level or an AnalyserNode.

items.name: agent-disclosure
items.title: Agent Disclosure
items.description: Shared clip-path reveal for collapsible agent content.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Inline citation markers, favicon stacks and a collapsible source list.

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message Bubble
items.description: Chat bubble surfaces with variants, pop-in entrance and a collapsible body.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Transcript viewport that follows streamed output and offers a turn-by-turn rail.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Message rows with avatar, header, footer, markers and a typing indicator.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: Auto-growing prompt box with model picker, action menu and send/stop.

items.name: agent-code
items.title: Agent Code
items.description: Shared Shiki tokenizer and code renderer used by agent components.

items.name: todo-list
items.title: Todo List
items.description: Live task plan with per-item progress and a rolling completed count.

items.name: tool-result
items.title: Tool Result
items.description: Tool call card for terminal, request and file output with status, copy and retry.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Streaming code block with Shiki highlighting, line highlights and copy.

items.name: file-diff
items.title: File Diff
items.description: Streaming unified diff with added/removed counts.

items.name: agent-activity
items.title: Agent Activity
items.description: Collapsible run log of steps, searches and tool calls.

items.name: loading-states
items.title: Loading States
items.description: Thinking shimmer, elapsed-time progress and rotating reasoning text.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval Card
items.description: Human-in-the-loop card: stepped questions or approve / request changes / reject.

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool Approval
items.description: Permission prompt for a tool call with parameters, allow once / always and deny.

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image Generation
items.description: Image generation frame with queued, generating, refining and complete states.

items.name: ai-sidebar
items.title: Ai Sidebar
items.description: Resource tree for agent workspaces: select, expand, drag to move and rename.

items.name: chat-app
items.title: Chat App
items.description: Chat application shell that folds its sidebar away when the shell gets narrow.

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming Response
items.description: Streamed answer with copy, retry, feedback and a sources footer.

items.name: question-card
items.title: Question Card
items.description: One question at a time in a sliding stack with an odometer step counter and auto-advance on single choice.

items.name: chat-panel
items.title: Chat Panel
items.description: Chat panel with context tabs, a scripted reply sequence that starts on send, and a composer.

items.name: recommendation-card
items.title: Recommendation Card
items.description: Recommendation with a confidence meter, an alternatives drawer that swaps the pick, and a confirm action.

items.name: context-cards
items.title: Context Cards
items.description: Retrieved context chunks that stagger in, then reveal their source file chips.

items.name: search-list
items.title: Search List
items.description: Command-style search with live filtering, a clear action, a gliding hover highlight and an empty state.

items.name: filter-table
items.title: Filter Table
items.description: Task table filtered by status chips; rows collapse in place and status pills are tinted by meaning.

items.name: flowchart
items.title: Flowchart
items.description: Workflow canvas with draggable Trigger and If/Else cards joined by a live bezier connector.

items.name: insight-cards
items.title: Insight Cards
items.description: Insights carousel with comparison, anomaly and allocation mini-charts and a blurred page crossfade.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: A composer with @ sources, / commands, a model picker, dictation and attachments, plus a self-running demo.

items.name: selection-actions
items.title: Selection Actions
items.description: A contextual AI bar under selected text that animates its width between modes and streams in a rewrite.

items.name: pixel-loader
items.title: Pixel Loader
items.description: A 3×3 pixel-grid loader with a shimmering status label and a live elapsed timer, in four motion variants.

items.name: thinking-trace
items.title: Thinking Trace
items.description: An expandable agent trace that shimmers while working, then settles. Steps, reasoning, search and coding variants.

items.name: streaming-answer
items.title: Streaming Answer
items.description: An answer that streams in word by word with an inline citation, then shows actions, sources and follow-ups.

items.name: task-rows
items.title: Task Rows
items.description: Task rows with progress rings, status pills and expandable details, run through a failed, retry, done sequence.

items.name: tool-chips
items.title: Tool Chips
items.description: An agent run as compact tool-call rows with inline chips, then file-diff chips that preview their diff on hover.

items.name: agent-screen
items.title: Agent Screen
items.description: Live agent-screen card that expands to a full-screen viewer with Teach-a-task recording.

items.name: code-panel
items.title: Code Panel
items.description: Light editor panel with a line-numbered Code view and a unified Diff view with word-level highlights.

items.name: fine-tune-card
items.title: Fine Tune Card
items.description: Compact inspector with scrub-able number fields, a sliding segmented control and a Type menu.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar Nav
items.description: Workspace switcher, primary nav and searchable chats that collapse to an aligned icon rail.

items.name: records-table
items.title: Records Table
items.description: AI spreadsheet grid with property popovers, row-by-row calculation, resizable sticky columns and sorting.

items.name: diff-table
items.title: Diff Table
items.description: A proposed table edit that plays once; click each changed row to keep or drop it before applying.

items.name: crm-pipeline
items.title: Crm Pipeline
items.description: Sales pipeline with a stage board, sortable list view, search, drag or menu moves, and a deal detail panel with an activity timeline.

items.name: analytics-dashboard
items.title: Analytics Dashboard
items.description: Analytics screen with range tabs, KPI cards, a metric chart, a sortable top-pages table and a channel breakdown.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings Page
items.description: Settings with profile, notifications, team and billing sections, an unsaved-changes bar and a type-to-confirm danger zone.

items.name: auth-screen
items.title: Auth Screen
items.description: Split sign-in and sign-up screen with validation, social providers, loading and error states, and a brand panel.

items.name: agent-workspace
items.title: Agent Workspace
items.description: AI agent chat workspace: conversation rail, thread with thinking, tool calls and streamed answers, prompt bar and a live task panel.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: Quantity Stepper
items.description: Minus, value and plus control with min, max and step, controlled or uncontrolled, with optional press-and-hold repeat.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Horizontal progress bar with a label row and a tone that follows how full or empty it is, for quotas and stock.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: KPI tile with a label, a large value, a change chip and an optional toggle-button mode, plus a grouped grid.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centered empty block with an optional icon, title, description and action slots, for tables, lists and cards.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Numbered step indicator for multi-step flows like checkout, horizontal or vertical, that never overflows on mobile.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Icon menu that switches between system, light and dark by toggling the dark class, and remembers the choice.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: Sticky top bar with a brand slot, nav links, an actions slot and a mobile menu.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: Qr Code
items.description: A real, scannable QR code drawn as an inline SVG, readable in light and dark themes.

items.name: ticket-pass
items.title: Ticket Pass
items.description: Digital ticket card with a title band, details grid, tear line, QR stub and a status badge.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: Three-step checkout (details, payment, confirmation) with validation, a sticky order summary with quantity steppers and discount codes, and ticket-pass confirmation. Card details stay in the form; only the last four digits reach your code.

items.name: catalog
items.title: Catalog
items.description: Browse and discovery screen: featured band, search, category chips, sort, price filter, availability switch, card grid, active filters, empty state and loading skeleton.

items.name: detail-page
items.title: Detail Page
items.description: Detail page with a sticky purchase panel: media, meta, key facts, tabs, tier selection with quantity, running total, checkout and waitlist.

items.name: order-confirmation
items.title: Order Confirmation
items.description: Order confirmed screen with a completed stepper, order number, stat row, one ticket pass per ticket, an order summary and download, calendar, view-tickets and continue actions.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Page title block with eyebrow, description, actions and breadcrumb slots, plus a container that gives every route the same width and gutters.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field wrapper that pairs a label, control, hint and error message and wires ids and ARIA attributes, with a responsive group and fieldset.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Single-date picker in a popover with an accessible month grid and an optional HH:MM time field (12h or 24h), using ISO string values.

items.name: repeater-field
items.title: Repeater Field
items.description: Add and remove rows editor for repeatable groups, with min/max, optional move up/down, live announcements and animated rows.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Vertical event timeline with status markers that never rely on color alone, mono timestamps, a side time column on wide containers, expandable detail, collapsible long lists, and loading and empty states.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callout with a per-variant icon, optional dismiss, an actions slot and a full-bleed banner mode for system, weather and policy notices.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: Shape plus word status (operational, degraded, down, maintenance) and an uptime bar of segments with an accessible summary.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or range slider on Radix with a label row, formatted value and marks.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: Drag-and-drop or click-to-browse file area with size, type and count validation, camera capture and a file list with progress. No upload logic.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: Otp Input
items.description: One-time-code entry on a single real input, with paste, a separator and complete, invalid and disabled states.

items.description: The theme plus every opendraft component.
